BiblicalUsage: This word is longing — the soul stretching toward what it desires. God tells Israel that when their soul longs to eat flesh, they may eat it; David is told the king has longed to see him; and Jeremiah pictures Judah as a wild ass in heat, sniffing the wind in her longing, running after other gods. The same longing can be lawful appetite or runaway desire.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that longing itself is not the sin — it is where the longing runs that matters. My soul was made to long for God, and when it runs anywhere else, it runs wild.
